page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.6xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. Configured with 24 dedicated virtual CPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, the instance delivers a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per allocated virtual core. The platform operates on the KVM hypervisor architecture to deliver predictable compute isolation.

The instance comes without local storage disks, requiring external cloud block storage attachments for persistent filesystem requirements. Networking specifications include a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default. It lacks dedicated hardware graphics processing units, keeping the architecture focused entirely on central memory and processing throughput.

By offering substantial memory density alongside dedicated compute resources, ecs.r8i.6xlarge targets memory-constrained operational profiles. Typical workload fits include in-memory databases, large-scale caching tiers, transactional enterprise databases, extensive data extraction pipelines, and analytics platforms requiring high memory retention without physical accelerators.
